18:75: Inna: "day ur ak nniɣ ara, kečč, s tideţ, ur tezmiṛeḍ, yidi, a ţṣebṛeḍ, d awezɣi"?
18:76: Inna: "ma steqsaɣ k ɣef tɣawsa, deffir ta, ur teddu yidi. Niɣ ssutreɣ ak d ssmaḥ".
18:77: Lḥan, armi bbwḍen ar imezdaɣ n yiwet n temdint, ssutren asen lqut. Ugin a ten snubgten. Ufan en lḥiḍ, qṛib ad iɣli. Iṣeggem it. Inna: "ma tebɣiḍ, tzemreḍ a ţţeţwaxellṣeḍ ɣef waya".
18:78: Inna: "Tura a nemfaṛaq. Ad ak d fkeɣ lmaɛna n wayen iɣef ur tezmireḍ a ţṣebṛeḍ, d awezɣi".
18:79: Lbabuṛ nni, n igellilen i ixedmen di yill. Bɣiɣ a t ṛẓeɣ, acku yiwen ugellid, deffir sen, itekkes yal lbabuṛ, s yiɣil.
18:80: Wanag ilemẓi nni, llan imawlan is d lmumnin. Nugad ad iḥeţţem fellasen tinufqa, tijehli.

18:82: Wanag lḥiḍ, n sin warrac igujilen n temdint. Illa ugerruj seddaw as, i nitni. Babat sen d argaz ilhan. Mass ik Ibɣa, ard imɣuṛen, ara d ssuffɣen agerruj nnsen. D aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ur t xdimeɣ s lameṛ iw. D tagi ay d lmaɛna n wayen iɣef ur tezmiṛeḍ a ţṣebṛeḍ".
18:83: Steqsan k ɣef Bu sin wacciwen. Ini: "ad awen d awiɣ, fellas, asmekti".

18:86: armi sanda iɣelli yiṭij. Iufa iɣelli ɣef tala iluɣen. Iufa n ɣuṛes agdud. Nenna: "a Bu sin wacciwen, ɛaqeb iten, neɣ lhu ɣuṛsen".
18:87: Inna: "win idensen a t nɛaqeb, sinna, ad iuɣal ar Mass is at Iɛaqeb aɛaqeb unekkaṛ.
18:88: Wanag i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, akafi igerzen. Ad as Nini i isehlen si lameṛ nneɣ".
18:90: armi sanda d ineqqeṛ yiṭij. Iufa n ineqqeṛ ed ɣef ugdud, iwumi ur Nefki ar at isdarin segs.
18:91: Am akka. Niɣ ibbweḍ aɣ d akw usali s.
18:93: armi ibbweḍ ger sin iḥdiden. Iufa, deffir sen, agdud qṛib ur fehhmen awal.
18:94: Nnan: "a Bu sin wacciwen, s tideţ, Iaouo akked Maouo la ssefsaden di tmurt. A k nxelleṣ ma terriḍ ṣṣuṛ garaneɣ yidsen".
18:95: Inna: "yif it iyi Ifka Mass iw. Efket iyi afus, ad rreɣ ṣṣuṛ garawen yidsen.
18:96: Awit iyi d tiqamtin n wuzzal alamma irgel wayen illan ger idurar". Inna: "ṣuḍet alamma tekker degs tmes. Awit iyi d ad smireɣ fellas nnḥas ifsin".
18:97: Dɣa ur zmiren a t id zegren, ur zmiren a t id flun.
18:98: Inna: "ayagi d aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass iw. Mi d tusa lemɛahda n Mass iw, a t Isawi. Lemɛahda n Mass iw d tideţ".
18:99: Assen, a ten Neoo ad ddehmen wa ɣef wa. Aṣuḍu di lbuq, dɣa a ten Nessemlil akw.
18:100: A d Nessken nezzeh Loahennama, assen, i ijehliyen,
18:101: wid iwumi sḥurrment wallen nnsen, mgal asmekti W. Llan ur zmiren i usemḥes.
18:102: Day ɣilen, wid ijehlen, ad rren imdanen iW, d imawlan war Nek? Ih, Nhegga Loahennama, d axxam i ijehliyen.
18:103: Ini: "ad awen mleɣ at igiten imexsuṛen sennig wiyaḍ?
18:104: Wid iwumi iweddeṛ laɛtab nnsen di tmeddurt n ddunit, wanag nitni nwan gerzen igi"?
18:105: Widak d wid i inekṛen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, akked temlilit yideS. Mḥan igiten nnsen. Ur ten Nwezzen, ass n tnekra.
18:106: Atan uqeṭṭi nnsen: Loahennama, imi jehlen, u mmaɛlken deg issekniyen iW, akked imazanen iW.
18:107: Ma d wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, axxam nnsen d leonanat n Loennet.
18:108: Degs ad wekkṛen, ur ssuturen ayen nniḍen.
18:109: Ini: "lemmer ill d lmidad, i wawalen n Mass iw, ad iqqaṛ yill, uqbel ad fukken wawalen n Mass iw, xas a d nawi i t icban n lmidad".
18:110: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weḥḥan iyi d ar Ṛebbi nnwen, d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Win issaramen timlilit n Mass is, ad ixdem ayen ilhan, ur iţcarak yiwen deg waɛbad n Mass is".
19:2: Asmekti uḥunu n Mass ik, i umdan iS Zakarya;
19:3: mi iger, i Mass is, tiɣṛi tabaḍnit.
19:4: Inna: "a Mass iw! S tideţ, ṛẓent laɛḍam iw, aqeṛṛu iṛeq si ccib. A Mass iw! Anuju ɣuṛeK uroin iyi isnuɣben.
19:5: Nek ugadeɣ llzem iw, deffir i. Tameṭṭut iw d tiɛiqeṛt. Efk iyi d lfeṛx sɣuṛeK;
19:6: ad iyi iwṛet, ad iwṛet si twacult n Yaɛqub. Err it, a Mass iw, d win iṛuḍan".
19:7: "A Zakarya, s tideţ, Nbecceṛ ik s uqcic, ism is Yeḥya. Ur Nefki, i yiwen, ism agi, uqbel is".
19:8: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sɛuɣ aqcic, tameṭṭut iw d tiɛiqeṛt, u nek ɣemqeɣ di tewser"?
19:9: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass ik: ayagi ishel fellI. Niɣ Xelqeɣ k, zik, ur telliḍ d acemma".
19:10: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur teţmeslayeḍ i medden, kraḍ waḍan, ur tuḍneḍ".
19:11: Iffeɣ ed ar ugdud is, si lemqam. Iweḥḥa yasen ad anzen ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit".
19:12: "A Yeḥya, eṭṭef Tazmamt, s loehd". D ṣṣebyan, Nefka yas ṣṣwab,

19:15: Tifrat fellas asmi d ilul, asmi ara immet, asmi ara d iuɣal d amuddir!
19:16: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Meryem, asmi taɛzel iman is, si twacult is, di tama ugmuḍ.
19:17: Terra ssteṛ garas yidsen. Nuzen as d ṛṛuḥ nneɣ. ɣuṛes, amzun d amdan ifuqen.
19:18: Tenna: "ad iyi Ḥerz Uḥnin, segk, ma teţḥezzibeḍ".
19:19: Inna: "nek, d amersul kan n Mass im, ad am fkeɣ aqcic iṣfan".
19:20: Tenna: "amek ara sɛuɣ aqcic, ur iyi innul umdan, ur lliɣ d tazennant"?
19:21: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass im: ayagi, ishel fellI. A t Nerr d assekni i medden, d aḥunu sɣuṛneɣ. D lameṛ iţţuḥeţţmen".
19:22: Tebbwi tadist; syis taɛzel iman is, di tama ibaɛden.
19:23: Bdan ţ id inzikmiren ar loedra n tezdayt. Tenna: "annaɣ lemmer mmuteɣ, uqbel ayagi, ad ţwaţţuɣ akw"!
19:24: Issawel as d, seddaw as: "kkes aɣwbel, ih, Mass im Irra iɣẓeṛ, seddaw am.
19:25: Hucc, ar ɣuṛem, loedra n tezdayt, ad am d iɣli ţţmeṛ amaynut ibwan.
19:26: Ečč, ssew, ssefṛeḥ iẓṛi m. Ma twalaḍ yiwen n umdan, ini as: nek, s tideţ, uẓameɣ i Uḥnin, ur ţmeslayeɣ, assa, i umdan".
19:27: Tṛuḥ yis ar ugdud is, tebbwi t. Nnan: "a Meryem! Niɣ tusiḍ d, s temsalt ihejjnen.
19:28: A ultmas n Haṛun, ur illi baba m d argaz ucmit, ur telli imma m d tazennant".
19:29: Teswɛad ɣuṛes. Nnan: "amek ara nemmeslay i ṣṣebyan di dduḥ"?
19:30: Inna: "nek d amdan n Ṛebbi. Ifka yi d Tazmamt. Irra yi d nnbi.
19:31: Iṛqa yi anda lliɣ. Iweṣṣa yi taẓallit, u zzakat, skud mazal iyi d amuddir.
19:32: Ad beddeɣ i yimma. Ur iyi Irri d aqehhaṛ, neɣ d ccaqi.
19:33: Tifrat felli asmi d luleɣ, asmi ara mmteɣ, asmi ara d uɣaleɣ d amuddir"!
19:34: D wagi ay d Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem. D awal n tideţ, iɣef cukken.
19:35: Ur iṣwib ara, i Ṛebbi, ad Isɛu kra n mmi S. Gedha syiS! Ma Iseyya lameṛ, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
19:36: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Mass iw, d Mass nnwen. Ihi, ɛabdet eP. D wagi ay d abrid uwqim.
19:37: Mgarraden ikabaren garasen. A tawaɣit n wid ijehlen, mara walin ass abarar!
19:38: Ara slen, ara walin, ass ideg ara d asen ɣuṛneɣ! Maca, imednas, assa, di ttelfan s ṣṣeḥ.
19:39: Nabi ten, ɣef ass n ssixṭa, mara iṣaṛ lameṛ. Nitni, di lɣeflan, nitni ur uminen.
19:40: Ih, d Nekwni, ara Iweṛten tamurt akked wayen illan fellas. ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnsen.
19:41: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Ibṛahim. Ih, Neţţa, illa d bab n tideţ, d nnbi.
19:42: Mi inna i baba s: "a baba! Acimi tɛabdeḍ win ur nsell, ur neţwali, ur k iţɣitin s wacemma?
19:43: Ih, a baba, Nek iţţunefk iyi d, si tmusni, ayen ur ak neţţunefk. Ihi ddu yidi, a k nhuɣ ar ubrid ilhan.
19:44: A baba! Ur ɛabbed Cciṭan. Niɣ Cciṭan illa d amɛaṣu i Uḥnin.
19:45: A baba! Nek, ugadeɣ a k iwwet uɛaqeb n Uḥnin, a ţţiliḍ d ameddakwel n Cciṭan".
19:46: Inna d: "day tugiḍ kečč, a Ibṛahim, iṛebbiten iw? Ma ur tfukkeḍ ara, war ccekk, a k ṛeomeɣ! Ṭixxeṛ iyi tallit ɣwezzifen".
19:47: Inna: "ili di tifrat. Ad ssutreɣ i Mass iw, ad ak Isemmeḥ. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iɛuzz iyi.
19:48: Ad ɛazleɣ iman iw segwen, akked wayen teţnujum, war Ṛebbi. Ad naɛṛeɣ Mass iw, ahat, s unuju w, ar Mass iw, ur ɣwebneɣ ara".
19:49: Mi iaɛzel iman is segsen akked wayen ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, Nefka yas Isḥaq akked Yaɛqub. Yal yiwen, Nerra t d nnbi.
19:50: Nefka yasen seg uḥunu nneɣ. Nerna yasen ccekṛan umɛin, lfayeq.
19:51: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Musa. Ih, neţţa, illa d aɛeṛḍi, d amazan, d nnbi.
19:52: Nessawel as d, si ṭṭeṛf ayeffus n udrar. Nessqeṛb it id, ad as Nmel.
19:53: Nefka yas, seg uḥunu nneɣ, gma s, Haṛun, d nnbi.
19:54: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Ismaɛil. Ih, neţţa, illa d win iţţaṭafen di lemɛahda s, d amazan, d nnbi.
19:55: Iumeṛ i twacult is, taẓallit, zzakat. Iṛuḍa t Mass is.
19:56: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Idris. Ih, neţţa, illa d bab n tideţ, d nnbi.
19:58: D wigi i Iɣat Ṛebbi, ger lambiyya, ger tarwa n Adem, ger wid i Nebbwi akked Nuḥ, ger tarwa n Ibṛahim, akked Isṛail, ger wid Nenha u Nefren. Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen n Uḥnin, ad ɣlin knan, s imeṭṭawen.
19:59: Lxwelf nnsen d asatu i iooan taẓallit, ddan d ccehwiyyat. Ad magren ttelfan.
19:60: Kkes ed wid isteṛoɛen, iumnen, xeddmen ayen ilhan. Wigi, ad kecmen Loennet, ur ţwadensen s wacemma.
19:61: Leonanat n Ɛaden i Iwaɛɛed Uḥnin, i imdanen iS, di tbaḍnit. Lemɛahda S, s tideţ, a ţţeḍṛu.
19:62: Ur sellen, degs, i yir awal, siwa: "tifrat"! Dinna, lqut nnsen, ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit.
19:63: D tagi ay d Loennet, ara Nerr d lweṛt, i wid iţḥezziben, seg imdanen nneɣ.
19:64: Ur d neţṣubbu, siwa ma s lameṛ n Mass ik. IneS i illan zdat nneɣ, i illan deffir nneɣ, akked wayen illan garasen. Mass ik ur Iteţţu.
19:65: Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ihi, ɛabed iT, ili d imezgi deg uɛbad iS. Day tesneḍ win isɛan ism iS?
19:66: La iqqaṛ umdan: "ma mmuteɣ, day a yi d ssuffɣen d amuddir"?
19:67: Day ur icfa ara umdan, ar t id Nxelq, zik, ur illi d acemma?
19:68: S Mass ik, ara ten Nefser, nitni akked cwaṭen. Sinna, a ten Nerr ad zzin i Loahennama, ɣef tgwecrar.
19:69: Sinna, a d Nekkes, si yal arbaɛ, wid ibeɣwḍen nezzeh, ar Uḥnin.
19:70: Sinna, d Nekwni, war ccekk, i Isnen sennig akw, imenza ar tmeṛɣiwt.
19:71: Akken tellam, a ţqeṛbem ɣuṛes. Akka, ar Mass ik, d aseyyi imuḥeţţmen.
19:72: Sinna, a Nsellek wid iţḥezziben. A Neoo degs, imednas, ɣef tgwecrar.
19:73: Mara asen ɣṛen issekniyen iberrzen nneɣ, qqaṛen wid ijehlen i wid iumnen: "menyif sin irebbuyaɛ di temɛict akw i lemwansa"?
19:74: Acḥal isuta i Nesqucc, uqbel nnsen, ifen ten tarkunt, ṣṣifa!
19:75: Ini: "ad Irnu Uḥnin di laɛmeṛ, i imɣeṛṛqen, alamma walan acu i sen iţţuwaɛɛden: d aɛaqeb neɣ d imir. Ad ẓṛen anwa illan deg umkan adiran maḍi, ay d bu lɛaskeṛ uṛhifen maḍi".
19:76: Ad Irnu Ṛebbi nnhaya i wid iţwanhan. Ar Mass ik, leṣlaḥ idumen ifen akafi, asisi.
19:77: Ma twalaḍ win iugin issekniyen nneɣ, u inna: "tarkunt, tarwa ad iyi ţţunefkent, war ccekk"?
19:78: Aɛni issen tabaḍnit, neɣ iuɣ lemɛahda sɣuṛ Uḥnin?
19:79: Xaṭi, a Naru ayen inna. Ad as Nessiɣwzef nezzeh aɛaqeb.
19:80: A Newṛet ay d inna, a d ias ɣuṛneɣ, d awḥid.
19:81: Xtaṛen, war Ṛebbi, iṛebbiten ar asen d iawin tazmert.
19:82: Xaṭi! Ad nekṛen aɛbad nnsen, ad asen uɣalen d ixṣimen.
19:83: Ur twalaḍ ara, Nuzen ed ccwaṭen i ijehliyen, la ten laɛjen s ljuṛ?
19:84: Ur ţḥiri fellasen, la Nessalay kan leḥsab nnsen.
19:85: Ass ideg ara Nefser wid iţḥezziben ar Uḥnin, d imaɛṛaḍen,
19:86: a Nenheṛ ijehliyen, d aqwḍaṛ, ar Loahennama.
19:87: Ur sɛin ccafuɛa, siwa win iuɣen lemɛahda ar Uḥnin.
19:90: Segs, qṛib flan igenwan, tcerreg tmurt, grurjen idurar s ẓdiḥ.
19:92: Ur iwjib ara, i Uḥnin, ad Isɛu mmi S.
19:93: Akken llan di tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ay d iteddun, ar Uḥnin, s waɛbad.
19:94: Ih, Iḥseb iten, Issen nezzeh amḍan nnsen.
19:95: Akw a d asen ɣuṛeS, ass n tnekra, yiwen yiwen.
19:96: War ccekk, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Iɛuzz Uḥnin.
19:97: Nerra t kan d ushil, s tmeslayt ik, iwakken a ţbeccṛeḍ, syis, wid iḥezzben, u a ţnedṛeḍ agdud iggernenn.
19:98: Acḥal isuta ay Nesqucc uqbel nnsen! Day a ţmagreḍ yiwen degsen, neɣ a ţţesleḍ i uswecwec nnsen?
20:2: Ur ak d Nessader ara Leqwṛan iwakken a ţɣwebleḍ.

20:17: D acu ţ tinna deg ufus ayeffus ik, a Musa"?
20:18: Inna: "d taɛkwazt iw, fellas tekkayeɣ, syis sseɣlayeɣ d iferrawen i lmal iw. Sseqdaceɣ ţ i wayen nniḍen".
20:21: Inna: "ddem iţ, ur ţţagwad, ad as Nerr udem is amenzu.
20:22: Eẓmeḍ afus ik, s idis ik. A d iffeɣ d amellal, ur ihlik. D assekni nniḍen,

20:38: mi Nweḥḥa, i yimma k, ayen i Nweḥḥa:

20:55: Segs, Nxelq ikwen; degs, a kwen Nerr; segs, a kwen id Nessuffeɣ, tikelt nniḍen.
20:56: Niɣ Nessken as akw issekniyen nneɣ inkeṛ, iugi.
20:57: Inna: "day aɣ d tusiḍ, s ssḥur ik, a Musa, ad aɣ tessuffɣeḍ seg wakal nneɣ?
20:58: War ccekk, ad ak d nawi ssḥur i t icban. Err garaneɣ yidek ţţaɛud, deg umekkan iwulmen, ur t nezgal, ur t tezgaleḍ".
20:59: Inna: "ţţaɛud nnwen ass n tmeɣṛa, a d mlilen medden, di tṣebḥit".
20:60: Izzi Ferɛun, ijmaɛ ed ccbukat is, dɣa iusa d.
20:61: Inna yasen Musa:"a tawaɣit nnwen! Ur d garet tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, a kwen Isxeḍ s uɛaqeb. Niɣ ad ixseṛ win d igren".
20:62: Mcawaṛen f lameṛ nnsen, ffren ayen mmeslayen.
20:63: Nnan: "ihi, sin agi d iseḥḥaren, bɣan a kwen ssuffɣen seg wakal nnwen, s ssḥur nnsen. Ad kksen abrid nnwen amxallef.
20:64: Jemɛat ed ccbukat nnwen, sinna aset ed d leṣfuf. Niɣ ad irbeḥ, assa, win iufraren"!
20:65: Nnan: "a Musa! A ţḍeggṛeḍ kečč, neɣ d nekwni ara iḍeggṛen d imezwura"?
20:66: Inna: "xaṭi, ḍeggṛet"! Si ssḥur nnsen, iwala amzun leḥḥun imraren akked tɛakwzin nnsen.
20:67: Musa, deg iman is, iḥus i lxuf.
20:68: Nenna: "ur ţţagwad! Kečč, s tideţ, sennig sen.
20:69: Veggeṛ i illan deg ufus ik ayeffus! Ad isseblaɛ ay d snulfan". Ay d snulfan, siwa ccbukat iseḥḥaren. Anda idda useḥḥar, ur irebbeḥ ara.
20:70: ɣlin iseḥḥaren, knan, nnan: "numen s Mass n Haṛun akked Musa".
20:71: Inna: "day tumnem yiS, uqbel i wen serrḥeɣ? Neţţa, ziɣ, d ameqwṛan nnwen. Isḥefḍ awen ssḥur. War ccekk, ad awen gezmeɣ, aḍaṛ sya, afus sya, u a kwen ṣemmṛeɣ af umidag n leodar n tezdayin. A ţţeẓṛem, s tideţ, anwa ay d bab uɛaqeb meqqwṛen, u ara idumen sennig wiyaḍ".
20:72: Nnan: "ur k nesmenyaf, d awezɣi, i wayen i ɣ d iusan ubeggen, akw i Win i ɣ Ixelqen. Seyyi i k ihwan a ţseyyiḍ. Aseyyi k, d aseyyi ɣef tmeddurt n ddunit agi kan.
20:73: Ih, numen s Mass nneɣ, iwakken ad aɣ Isemmeḥ tuccḍa nneɣ, akked wayen n ssḥur i tḥeţţmeḍ fellaneɣ. Pifxiṛ Ṛebbi d Imezgi".
20:74: Ih, Loahennama i win iusan ar Mass is, d abeɣwḍi. Ur iţmeţţat degs, ur d iţţidir.
20:75: Win i iusan ɣuṛeS d lmumen u ixdem ayen ilhan, widak ad ilin deg imukan aɛlayen maḍi,
20:76: leonanat n Ɛaden, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, ad wekkṛen din. Ayagi, d akafi i win zeddigen.
20:77: Niɣ Nweḥḥa i Musa: "ṛuḥ, deg iḍ, akked imdanen iW. Egg asen abrid akiwan, di yill. Ur ţţagwad a kwen in ḍefṛen, ur ţţiwḥic".
20:78: Ferɛun, s iɛsekṛiwen is, ḍefṛen ten. Isseblaɛ ten yill, ičča ten.
20:80: A yAt Isṛail! Niɣ Nsellek ikwen seg ucangu nnwen. Nefka yawen ţţaɛud, ar loiha tayeffus n udrar. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeṛṛuoen.
20:81: Eččet si lmakla ilhan, i s ikwen Nɣat. Ur zegret tilas fellas, mulac a kwen immager urrif iW. Win immuger urrif iW, niɣ igrareb.
20:82: U Nek, s tideţ, Psemmiḥeɣ i win isteṛoɛen, iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, dɣa iţwanha.
20:83: "Acu i k iɣeṣben seg ugdud ik, a Musa"?
20:84: Inna: "zgan deffir i. ɣawleɣ d ɣureK, a Mass iw, iwakken a Pṛaḍiḍ".
20:85: Inna: "ih, niɣ Njeṛṛeb agdud ik, deffir ek. Itelf iten Usamiri".
20:86: Iuɣal ed Musa s agdud is, s zzɛaf d wumri. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day ur awen Ifka ara, Mass nnwen, lemɛahda lɛali? Day tɛaṭṭel fellawen lemɛahda? Neɣ day tebɣam a kwen immager urrif n Mass nnwen? Tzeglem ţţaɛud iw".
20:87: Nnan: "ur nezgil ţţaɛud ik, s lebɣi nneɣ. Maca, nbubb tiɛakkwmin n ṛṛḥuḥ n ugdud, dɣa nḍeggeṛ iten. Akken i iḍeggeṛ Usamiri".
20:88: Issuffeɣ asen d aɛejmi, d ameslux isrugmuten. Nnan: "wagi d ṛebbi nnwen u d ṛebbi n Musa. Iţţu".
20:89: Day ur walan ara, ur asen d iţţara awal, ur izmir a ten iḍuṛṛ, neɣ a ten infaɛ?
20:90: Niɣ Haṛun inna yasen, uqbel: "a yagdud iw! Teţţuhewwlem kan, yis. Mass nnwen, s tideţ, d Aḥnin. Ddut yidi, ḍefṛet lameṛ iw".
20:91: Nnan: "ur tneţfukku akaber is, d awezɣi, alamma iuɣal ed Musa ɣuṛneɣ".
20:92: Inna: "a Haṛun! D acu i k iṭṭfen, mi ten twalaḍ nnetlafen?
20:93: Day ur teddiḍ ara yidi? Day tugiḍ lameṛ iw"?
20:94: Inna: "a mmi s n yimma! Ur iyi ţţaṭṭaf si tamart iw, neɣ seg uqeṛṛu w. Nek, s tideţs, ugadeɣ ad iyi d tiniḍ: tessemfaṛaqeḍ At Isṛail, ur tuɣeḍ awal iw".
20:95: Inna: "d acu t leqsed ik a Usamiri"?
20:96: Inna: "walaɣ ayen ur walan. Ddmeɣ d tummeẓt n lateṛ umazan, ḍeggṛeɣ ţ. Akka ay ḥusseɣ deg iman iw".
20:97: Inna: "ṛuḥ ihi, a ţţeḍṛu yidek di tmeddurt a ţţeqqaṛeḍ: ur iyi ţnalet! U, s tideţ, ɣuṛek ţţaɛud ik ur tezmireḍ a t tzegleḍ. Muqel ṛebbi ik, uɣuṛ mazal teqqimeḍ, ard a t nesseṛɣ, a t ssebruzzaɛ ar yill, wakali".
20:98: Mass nnwen, siwa Ṛebbi. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Tamusni S tjemmel yal cci.
20:99: Akka i k Nḥekku, seg isallen n zik. Niɣ Nefka yak d, sɣuṛneɣ, asmekti.
20:100: Win i s iwexxṛen, ad iɛabbi taɛkkwemt, ass n tnekra.
20:101: Ad wekkṛen dinna. Ay dir iţ fellasen ţţaɛbga, ass n tnekra!
20:102: Ass ideg ara d ṣuḍen di lbuq, a d Nefser ibeɣwḍiyen, zgezwen assen.
20:103: Ad swecwicen wa i wa: "mraw kan i teqqimem".
20:104: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Nessen, ayen d qqaṛen, mi sen inna yiwen umxallef degsen: "teqqimem kan ibwass".
20:105: Steqsayen k ɣef idurar. Ini: "a ten Issebruzzaɛ Mass iw, d iwzan.
20:107: Ur teţwaliḍ degs i iɛawjen, neɣ i izzren".
20:108: Assen, ad ḍefṛen aberraḥ, war zzrug. Ad irs ṣṣut zdat Uḥnin, a ţţesleḍ kan i uswecwec.
20:109: Assen, ur ten tenfaɛ ccafuɛa, siwa i win Iooa Uḥnin, u Iṛuḍa t ɣef wawal.
20:110: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur illi sanda ara T issinen.
20:111: Ad ṭṭinzen wudmawen i Umuddir n lebda. Ara ixesṛen d win ibubben ddens.
20:112: Win ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u neţţa iumen, ur iţţagwad ddens, neɣ aqhaṛ.
20:113: Akka, Nessers it id, d Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt. Nenewwel ed, degs, aɛeggen, amar ad ḥezben, u a ten id ias usmekti.
20:114: D Ameqwṛan Ṛebbi, Agellid, Tideţ. Ur ţḥiri, di tɣuṛi, uqbel ma ifukk uweḥḥi s, ɣuṛek. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ernu yi di tmusni".
20:115: Niɣ Nɛahed, zik, Adem. Iţţu, ur Nufi ɣuṛes laɛzem.
20:116: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis i iugin.
20:117: Nenna: "a Adem, wagi, s tideţ, d acengu k, akked tmeṭṭut ik. ɣurwat a kwen id issuffeɣ, si Loennet, a ţɣweblem.
20:118: Ih, kečč, degs, ur teţlaẓeḍ, ur tɛarruḍ.
20:119: S tideţ, kečč, degs, ur teţfadeḍ, ur k iṭṭuṛṛu yiṭij".
20:120: Iɣwa t Cciṭan, inna: "a Adem, ad ak ssekneɣ ttejṛa uwekkeṛ, akw n tgelda n lebda"?
20:121: Eččan segs, dɣa walan iman nnsen ɛaryan, bdan la tessṛen iman nnsen, s iferrawen n Loennet. Adem iaɛṣa Mass is, idda di leɣwlaḍ.
20:122: Sinna, Ifren it Mass is, Issuref as, Inha t.
20:123: Inna: "ṣṣubet segs akw, wa d acengu n wa. Ma tusa kwen id nnhaya, sɣuṛI, win iddan d nnhaya iW, ur iţţutellef, ur iɣwebbel.
20:124: Win iooan asmekti W, tameddurt is d tucmiţ. Ass n tnekra, a t Nefser d aderɣal".
20:125: A d yini: "a Mass iw! Acimi iyi Tfesreḍ d aderɣal, niɣ lliɣ ţwaliɣ?
20:126: A d Yini: "akken i k id iusan ssekniyen nneɣ, teţţuḍ iten, akken ara teţwaţţuḍ, assa".
20:127: Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi win izegren tilas, ur numin s issekniyen n Mass is. U, s tideţ, aɛaqeb n laxeṛt iwɛaṛ kteṛ, u ad idum kteṛ.
20:128: Day ur ten inha ara wacḥal isuta i Nesqucc, uqbel nnsen? La leḥḥun ɣef tnezduɣin nnsen. Deg wayagi, s tideţ, d issekniyen i imawlan n ddehn.
20:129: Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, sɣuṛ Mass ik, akked lajel iţwassnen, yili, war ccekk, iṣaṛ uɛaqeb.
20:130: Ihi, bibb ayen d qqaṛen, sbuccaɛ s ccekṛan Mass ik, uqbel ad inqeṛ yiṭij, uqbel ad iɣli, deg iḍ. Anez di leḍṛuf n wass, amar fellak aṛaḍi.
20:131: Ur ţţara allen ik ar wayen i Nefka i kra n twaculin nnsen. D ajeooig n tmeddurt di ddunit, iwakken a ten Njeṛṛeb yis. Aɣiti n Mass ik yif it, u ad idum kteṛ.
20:132: Ameṛ taẓallit i twacult ik, ḥerz iţ. Ur ak Nessutur ṛṛeẓq, d Nekwni ara k Iṛeẓqen. Laɛquba d aḥezzeb.
20:133: Nnan: "a lemmer i ɣ d iusi s ussekni sɣuṛ Mass is"! Day ur ten id iusa ara ubeggen, deg wayen illan di tewṛeqtin timezwura?
20:134: Lemmer iten Nesqucc s uqeṭṭi, uqbel neţţa, a d inin, war ccekk: "a Mass nneɣ! Acimi ur aɣ d Tunzeḍ ara amazan? A neddu d issekniyen iK, uqbel a nendell u a neţţuqeṭṭi".
20:135: Ini: "akw, la neţgani. Ihi gganit. A ţţissinem anwi i iddan d ubrid ilhan, anwi i iţwanhan".
